claims.evidence: FSA: reheat leftovers only once; cook to steaming hot throughout.

claims.evidence: NHS inform defines cross-contamination as bacteria moving from one object to another, e.g. raw food dripping onto cooked food.

claims.newSentence: NHS inform advises separate boards and utensils for raw and ready-to-eat foods, and a Buckinghamshire Healthcare NHS Trust sheet advises storing raw meat in a sealed container on the bottom shelf of the fridge.

claims.evidence: FSA: use separate chopping boards and utensils where possible; prepare vegetables first, raw meat last. 'Unwashed vegetables apart from ready-to-eat' not retrieved.
claims.newSentence: The Food Standards Agency advises using separate chopping boards and utensils for raw meat and other foods where possible.
